nom: CHARDE Peel Off Cream Mask for Dark Spots

avis.titre: My Skin Felt Fresh After Using It
avis.texte: I used this mask as part of my evening routine, and I liked how easily it peeled off without being uncomfortable. My skin felt smoother and looked refreshed afterward. It’s become a nice little self-care step that I look forward to using each week.

I am absolutely thrilled with this CHARDE Peel Off Cream Mask! The cream-to-clear formula is incredibly unique and so satisfying to peel off once it dries down. After incorporating it into my routine, I’ve already noticed my dark spots starting to fade and my overall complexion looking significantly brighter and more even-toned. It leaves my face feeling soft, refreshed, and radiant without causing any irritation or stripping my skin. If you're looking for an effective and easy-to-use mask to level up your at-home skincare game, I highly recommend giving this one a try!
Well this didn't remove my dark spots in one application like the video shows but it did leave my skin very dewy and soft feeling. Time will tell if the spots will go away. I will update in a month.
The item was fine. Doesn't help with dark spots at all but is hydrating. I ordered it twice and it was supposed to be here overnight. It was late both times.
The Instagram ad is really misleading. The mask is not making the dark spot lighter at all. I do not think it’s a bad mask, but the marketing team really should not spread UGC ad like that.
It’s nice for my skin. So far my spots are still there. I only used it 3 times. Time will tell.
40分も待てません 結構、早めに乾くのに、40分も待つってなかなかできなくて、最長30分で剥がしてしまいました しっとりして、モチモチ肌になります シミや色むらが薄くなるって言ってる人がいたから買ってみたけど、もういいかな

avis.titre: Great mask and fun to use
avis.texte: This 1.69 fluid ounce tube of peel off cream by Charde is meant to target dark spots to lighten them and prevent them. Many of the ingredients inhibit melanin production. Fading spots will take time of course, but after using one time I noticed that my skin already appeared smoother and more uniform which was a pleasant surprise. I love the spatula it comes with; it makes spreading the cream a lot easier and less messy and it works really well. I plan on using it with some other mask products I have and struggled with applying the product smoothly. The cream dries kind of shiny on your skin; after 40 minutes you peel it off like glue on your fingers in kindergarten; both are very satisfying to do, especially if you can manage to pull it off all in one piece. It's kind of a fun experience! I'm not sure how many applications you can get out of the tube but the current price of $25 seems like a great deal if you can get 10 applications, making it comparable to a lower end facial mask. I think you should be able to get more than 10 applications though.

I'm always on the lookout to improve dark spots on my face,so grabbed this item. At $25, the cost is average for this type of product. My other similar masks are overnight ones, so I liked that this one was shorter and I didn't have to sleep with it on. There isn't much information about the product on the tube itself, so I didn't know how often to use it, but am starting at only 2x per week due to my sensitive skin. It's in a smaller tipped tube and comes out a creamy white. I didn't detect any odor to it. I applied a thin layer all over my face with the tool, except the eyelids and immediate eye areas and the lips. It says to leave on for 40 minutes, which I did. I'm used to overnight masks where I eat while waiting for the mask to set (because I'm impatient and always hungry) - I wouldn't recommend it with this one. After about 15 to 20 minutes, the area around my mouth was set enough that the mask was beginning to wrinkle up around the areas of my mouth that moved while chewing. This meant that the mask was not able to be flush against my skin for the balance of the time, so I don't think those areas were hydrated as much. When I removed it, my skin felt very hydrated. The peel removed easily, and I didn't see or feel any irritation on my sensitive skin. I patted the rest of the serum in, waited for it to set a little, then continued with moisturizer and my morning makeup routine. I didn't see this cause any issues with application or any difference in staying power. Howe

avis.titre: A modern take on the classic peel off mask
avis.texte: I've been looking for a good peel off face mask for hydration and overall skin toning for ages, and it seems like they've truly gone out of fashion. I've tried many other overnight masks, mud masks, and gel masks that rinse off, and none of them have done quite the same job of controlling my oily areas without drying out my dry areas, and generally clearing up my skin like the classic peel off masks I used in high school. This mask does all of that, and helps lighten dark spots and generally even out skin tone. It's alleviated redness in my cheeks and helped with my fine lines around my eyes, and you can SEE the dead skin and gunk it pulls out of your pores when you peel it off. I love this and will be getting more in the future. 5 stars.

This wrapping mask has a lot of actives going on, including retinol on top of acids I normally wouldn't stack with retinol. It also contains irritants including perfuming ingredients and denatured alcohol that I would normally avoid in skincare altogether. I have used a few other products from CHARDE that I've quite liked, but they've never been my go-to brand. This wrapping mask dries down on your skin kind of like Elmer's glue and peels off similarly. Be careful around your hairline because I almost always get wrapping masks stuck in my hair and it's extra hard to get out there without just taking a shower and washing my hair. I just feel like this mask has too much going on and is likely to result in irritation, especially for sensitive skin and/or skin that isn't used to retinol. You should always introduce retinol into your routine slowly so you can adjust to it, as it increases cell turnover but can result in dryness and irritation at first. The day after using this mask I fell asleep without doing any skincare, and the next day I had some mild dryness and flakiness all over my face, even in areas that don't normally do that. The fragrance is quite strong in my opinion so if you're sensitive to that, too, I would skip this one. I have combination skin that leans dry around the nose and mouth but I am not especially sensitive and have been working on easing retinol back into my routine lately. I don't think I will continue to use this mask simply because it stacks retino

avis.titre: Gentle Brightening Mask with Satisfying Peel-Off Finish
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using the CHARDE Peel Off Cream Mask for Dark Spots. The texture starts off as a cream and then dries into a clear peel-off mask, which is pretty satisfying to remove. It spreads easily on the skin and doesn’t feel overly tight or uncomfortable while it dries. After using it, my skin looked a bit brighter and more refreshed, and it felt smooth to the touch. It’s a nice addition to an at-home skincare routine when you want a little extra glow and care for uneven-looking skin. Another great thing is that it’s made in Korea, which is known for high-quality skincare and innovative formulas. The mask feels gentle on the skin and is easy to peel off without being too harsh. It’s a fun and convenient mask to use at home if you’re looking to add a brightening step to your skincare routine.

avis.titre: Relaxing face mask that gives a healthy glow
avis.texte: This peel off mask is easy to apply and remove. I had no trouble in removing the mask in one large piece which surprised me. The skin was left well moisturized with a clean and glass like appearance. I had no skin irritation or redness while the mask was on my face or upon removing the mask — just a healthy glow. The mask has become a staple in my weekly routine over the last month or so. I can’t tell you it has removed years of sun damage but it does make my pores appear smaller, my face feel plumper and perhaps just a better healthy look. The dark spots are beginning to lighten but I don’t expect any mask to work miracles in just a month. The tube is a good size and I did not need to use a lot of product to cover my face . I think the tube will last me more than a few months. It was nice that the seller included a mask application brush but honestly, my fingers spread it just fine. It is a good value for the money.

I like this peel off mask! Normally I don’t like masks that peel, but this one comes off easily in one big film and doesn’t tug or pull my skin. The instructions say to leave a thick layer on for 40 minutes, then peel it off. Mine was dry around 30 mins! It goes on like a thick gel/cream and starts to change to clear/milky. There’s a very slight perfume-like scent, which I think smells pleasant. No irritation at all! I have perimenopausal skin that’s showing major signs of aging. I don’t think this product was life changing, but it definitely makes my skin soft and smooth. Pretty good value for the price, I just wish it was bigger! The silicone spatula it comes with is pretty nice, too.

avis.titre: Nice Glow and Hydration, But Dark Spots Take Patience
avis.texte: I’ve been trying the Charde Melapeel Cream Mask since the day it arrived as dark spots is my number 1 skin concern now, and overall I’ve had a pretty positive experience with it. The texture is fun -- it starts out as a creamy layer and then slowly dries into a thin, transparent film that you can peel off. Using the included silicone brush makes application really easy and helps spread it evenly without making a mess. I'm so glad Charde included the brush. What I noticed right away was how hydrated my skin felt after removing the mask. My face looked smoother and definitely had a brighter, healthy glow. It gives that “glassy skin” look that’s really nice before going out or after a long day when your skin feels dull. The peel-off process itself is also much gentler than I expected. It doesn’t tug painfully like some peel-off masks do and comes off fairly easily once it’s fully dry. As for the dark spot and pigmentation claims, I think it’s important to be realistic. My overall skin tone did look a bit brighter, but dark spots and pigmentation don’t improve overnight. That kind of thing usually takes consistent care and time, so I wouldn’t expect instant results after only a few uses. One small downside is the drying time. It can take quite a while to fully set depending on how thick you apply it, so it’s not the quickest mask for busy days. I like the hydration and glow it gives my skin, and it feels gentle and comfortable to use. However, for dark spots and brighter-looking

avis.titre: nice glow mask, just not a dark spot treatment
avis.texte: i’ve tried several products from charde at this point and honestly i’ve enjoyed all of them, so i went into this with pretty good expectations. this one fits that same vibe. i’ve been using it in place of my exfoliation nights sometimes, not on top of everything else. it goes on like a creamy gel and the applicator is a nice bonus to help spread it evenly. it dries down into that peel-off layer. peeling it off is satisfying and my skin does feel really smooth after. for me this works more as a glow boost than anything else. my skin looks fresher the next day, makeup sits a little better. but this is not strong enough to erase dark spots. it’s more of a surface level smoothing and brightening moment. also if your skin is sensitive, i’d be a little careful because it does have actives plus that peel-off effect. i use it on nights when i want a break from stronger exfoliants or just want my skin to look good the next day. for the price, it’s fair. i’d use it up and enjoy it, just wouldn’t rely on it as a real treatment product.

I personally found this mask to be a bit drying, but I expected it to be since it contains retinol which is known for causing dryness and usually needs to be followed up with a nice moisturizer and almost any product I’ve ever seen it in. I do feel like the formula helped to lighten some darker spots that I had occurring, especially after several uses. There are quite a few uses in one bottle so I did feel like it was fairly cost-effective and at about the same price point as similar high-quality products. The peel off portion of the mask worked fairly well, it’s definitely not one that the entire thing comes off in a smooth sheet, but it was not super hard to remove.
